title: Constitutional Midtraining: Content Presence Drives Alignment Gains
abstract: arXiv:2607.26654v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Post-training alignment is often shallow, eroding under fine-tuning. It remains untested as to whether constitutional midtraining interventions can produce durable alignment when cleanly isolated from post-training. We build a 394M-token constitutional corpus from Anthropic's Constitution and apply constitutional midtraining at 120B scale, where principled, values-based content is inserted into midtraining. A 2x2 design (curriculum ordering x deliberative reasoning) was used to produce four constitutionally midtrained conditions, plus a control, which were evaluated on self-generated and established benchmarks including alignment under pressure, value conflict resolution, blackmail, and emergent misalignment. All models were evaluated across three stages: post-midtraining, post-SFT, and post-benign fine-tuning. translated_title: 宪法中期训练：内容存在性驱动对齐收益
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.26654v3 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：后期训练的对齐往往是浅层的，在微调下容易退化。目前尚未测试宪法中期训练干预措施在完全隔离后期训练的情况下，能否产生持久的对齐效果。我们基于Anthropic的宪法构建了一个3.94亿词元的宪法语料库，并在120B规模下应用宪法中期训练，将基于原则、价值观的内容插入中期训练中。采用2x2设计（课程排序x审慎推理）产生了四种宪法中期训练条件，外加一个对照组，并在自生成和既有基准上评估，包括压力下的对齐、价值冲突解决、勒索和突发性错位。所有模型在三个阶段进行评估：中期训练后、监督微调后和良性微调后。宪法中期训练的模型在对齐泛化和持久性方面优于对照组，尤其在勒索场景中表现突出。
tldr: 本文提出宪法中期训练方法，通过在中期训练中插入宪法内容，显著提升了对齐的泛化能力和持久性，尤其在勒索等压力场景下优于后期训练。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces constitutional midtraining, which inserts constitutional content during midtraining to significantly improve alignment generalization and durability, particularly outperforming post-training in blackmail scenarios.
